target.description: Original Figure 3 sentence-response prediction on all 1500 sentences and three original evaluation participants, preserving the baseline1000 companion and original participant-mean Pearson reduction.

dataset.description: Author OSF ru38b release as loaded by brain-lang-data_participant_20230728.csv and associated GPT2-XL last-token activations; raw fMRI, blocked data and supplementary modify data are distinct assets.

cohort.description: Train IDs 848, 853, 865, 875 and 876; original main evaluation IDs 797, 841 and 880. The two other released event-related evaluation participants and four blocked-design participants are not interchangeable with this cohort.

split.description: Train the encoding map on the original five-person 1,000-sentence baseline response set; evaluate on the original three-person 1,500-sentence search set. The 1,000 baseline sentences recur across people; only the 500 drive/suppress sentences are new stimuli. New nested splits are extensions.

inputs.description: Predictor inputs are the original sentence text/source representations and permitted original training-participant responses. Author comparator uses GPT2-XL last-token layer22 plus ridge. Item IDs are joining identifiers only, not model covariates. B/D/S condition labels and any metadata revealing heldout response-selection condition are evaluator-side companion-scoring metadata, not additional prediction features. Final response columns and saved author predictions remain evaluator-owned; historical public exposure is disclosed.

preprocessing.description: Match the released GLMsingle response extraction and bySessVoxZ normalization; retain the functionally localized lang_LH_netw target rather than switching to an anatomical ROI or a voxel subset. Source script records the exact extraction parameter identifiers.

metric.description: Pearson correlation r=sum((prediction-mean(prediction))*(response-mean(response)))/sqrt(sum((prediction-mean(prediction))^2)*sum((response-mean(response))^2)) across the original 1,500 sentence items.

aggregation.description: Select lang_LH_netw, participants797,841,880 and every original item1..1500 exactly once per person. Average normalized response_target over the three people for each item, then Pearson-correlate with one candidate prediction per item. Retain baseline1..1000 and original drive/suppress subsets as source companions and participant diagnostics. Do not pool4500rows as independent observations.

comparison.primary_metric: Fig. 3 Pearson correlation across the original 1,500 sentence-level mean evaluation responses

published_baseline.description: The pinned MIT author-final text (SHA256 f2a1ddaa09472459c832fe00a5012ec18d1403d7dcb23c70535b7647bc61783b) reports r=0.43(all1500) and r=0.30(baseline1000); final publisher numeric equivalence remains unresolved. Saved released-author predictions must be scored on the identical source panel and remain distinct from an independently refitted strongest relevant author comparator.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author fit/apply and figure code provide a reproducible route, but no source-matched original Fig. 3 replay receipt is admitted here. Existing prescribed ridge/LOOCV reconstruction evidence is a different grading target.

minimum_effect.rationale: Resolve the final source coefficient and reproduce it before choosing a meaningful prediction gain. The noise-ceiling simulation, p-value and arbitrary increment cannot define the improvement margin.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired candidate-minus-author correlation comparison with dependence-aware uncertainty over sentences and participants; report the fixed three-person estimand separately from population generalization.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Sentence stimulus crossed with participant; only three independent evaluation people
uncertainty.rationale: Pooling 4,500 rows as independent would duplicate stimuli and people. Source significance against zero does not test improvement over the author model.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate source final-publication numerical identity and complete original five-person/1000-item training and three-person/1500-item evaluation support.

Reproduce the source-author GPT2-XL last-token layer22 ridge route with original response normalization and fitting selection, retaining both saved-source and independently refitted author comparators.
Freeze candidate before evaluator target access and retain all original1500items, three people, baseline1000 and drive/suppress companions; repeated baseline stimuli remain disclosed.

Require meaningful improvement in original pooled Pearson r over the strongest relevant source comparator under a prespecified dependency-aware decision; report all companion/participant results without replacing the metric.

Improved prediction is the selected performance result. Biological drive/suppress effects, blocked robustness and linguistic findings remain separately retained reproduction, not a required larger effect or a claim established by better r.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA claim is made; a different language-encoding dataset or cross-validation protocol is not a comparator for this source experiment.

episode.improvement_loop: Once the final source baseline is recovered, develop encoding changes on original train-participant data with training-only validation and a declared feature/model exposure policy. Treat published targets and cached predictions as known exposures that require isolation.
episode.candidate_freeze: Seal feature model, preprocessing, fitting/selection recipe and prediction code before original evaluation responses are supplied to the trusted evaluator.
episode.final_evaluation: Source-identical Figure3 comparison on all1500original items and three people, with baseline/condition/participant companions and distinct published/saved-author/refitted-author/candidate results. Retained biological findings are separately named; no whole-paper biological or current-SOTA claim follows.
episode.baseline_policy: Use the pinned author fit/apply/figure route and preserve its original train/evaluation identities. A locally rewritten ridge baseline, historical numeric-tolerance grader or exploratory modify comparison is not the paper baseline.

blocking_issues: Confirm author-final Figure3 r0.43(all1500) and r0.30(baseline1000) against final publication; rounded values are not exact acceptance thresholds.

Authenticate complete original training responses/feature rows, response normalization, official model-selection and strongest relevant author predictor/reference on this exact panel; saved author predictions are not an independent refit.
Bind authentic candidate prediction/output manifests, original item/condition rows, runtime and a source-matched author fit/apply execution; no qualifying execution is supplied here.

Finalize common source inputs and code-only assistance manifests, paired budgets, candidate freeze and evaluator-owned target isolation. Original public responses/predictions are historically exposed.

Predeclare meaningful prediction gain and participant/stimulus-aware uncertainty with a joint pooled/baseline/condition reporting rule; no effect-size, significance or simulation-ceiling substitution.

legacy.notes: Prior broad biological reproduction and historical calibration remain unchanged in canonical files outside primary-endpoint-v1; this selected source endpoint does not assert they were already reproduced or exceeded.
